title: Playwright plugin
summary: Lets Claude drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms and take screenshots.
benefit: Claude can open, test and screenshot web pages itself.
details: Once installed, you can ask Claude to open a web page, click, fill a form and take a screenshot, and it drives a real browser to do it. It helps when you test a site or want to see how a page behaves. It is a plugin from the official marketplace; nothing ships with this pack, and a browser automation server starts only when it is used, which can open web pages.
risk: Installed from the official marketplace; starts a browser automation server when used, which can open web pages.
